title: Answer: experienced time is a window of presence, and identity across it is virtual

statements.text: The theory has no theory of physical time. Experienced time is a window of presence, an island of the now in the flow of physical time, structured further by dynamicity. A person’s identity across time is formed only virtually by the self-model, and minimal phenomenal experience lacks time representation altogether.

sources.quote: the generation of an island of presence in the continuous flow of physical time
The phenomenological prototype would be characterized by a complete absence of time-representation
